textos.Várias reviews medianas consideram que a: Several middling reviews consider the more than five hours tiring and say the film is slow to get going, with stretches that could be shortened without loss.
textos.A comunicação falha ou ausente entre cas: The failed or absent communication between couples, relatives and friends is identified as the film's thematic core, and some reviews value how this is explored.
textos.Parte das reviews medianas diz não conse: A portion of the middling reviews say they cannot connect or empathize with the protagonists, finding their attitudes self-centered or incomprehensible.
textos.As atuações, muitas vezes de não profiss: The performances, often by non-professionals, are praised for their naturalness, although some reviews consider them monotonous or too theatrical.
textos.Comparação com outras obras de Hamaguchi: Comparison with other works by Hamaguchi
textos.Diversas reviews medianas comparam este: Several middling reviews compare this film with later works by the director, considering that similar themes were handled more concisely and movingly in other films.
textos.Roteiro dispersivo e falta de foco: Scattered script and lack of focus
textos.Algumas reviews apontam que o roteiro se: Some reviews point out that the script branches out too much and loses its dramatic center, making the experience dragging and not very cohesive.
textos.Duração longa e ritmo contemplativo: Long running time and contemplative pace
textos.Muitas reviews destacam que, apesar das: Many reviews highlight that, despite the more than five hours, the film does not feel slow; the length is felt as an immersion that lets you follow the characters' lives naturally and even leaves you wishing it lasted longer.
textos.As reviews elogiam a profundidade das qu: The reviews praise the depth of the four protagonists, their nuances and the way each one deals differently with relationships, personal crises and her own identity.
textos.Amizade feminina como eixo emocional: Female friendship as the emotional axis
textos.A amizade entre as mulheres é apontada c: The friendship among the women is identified as the heart of the film, a form of love and support that permeates even the moments when they are apart, offering a sense of belonging and identity.
textos.Diálogos e conversas como motor narrativ: Dialogue and conversations as narrative engine
textos.O texto elogia a escrita dos diálogos, q: The writing praises the dialogue, which sounds natural and philosophical without losing its everyday quality, and the way the conversations reveal layers of meaning and unspoken tensions.
textos.Crítica social ao casamento e às institu: Social critique of marriage and institutions
textos.As reviews observam que o filme examina: The reviews observe that the film closely examines marriage, divorce and the social pressures on women in Japan, portraying heterosexual relationships as unsatisfying and exploring the bureaucracy of divorce.
textos.A abordagem naturalista e as atuações, i: The naturalistic approach and the performances, including the work with non-professional actresses, are highly praised for giving the characters authenticity and humanity.

textos.Lançado em 2015 e dirigido por Ryusuke H: Released in 2015 and directed by Ryusuke Hamaguchi, the drama Happy Hour follows four women in their thirties who reassess their personal and shared relationships. This process begins after an unexpected revelation about the marriage of one of them, leading them to question their own identity.
textos.Com mais de cinco horas de duração, a ob: At more than five hours long, the work adopts a slow, contemplative pace, structured around long conversations and the detailed observation of interpersonal dynamics.
textos.Os diferentes grupos de recepção concord: The different reception groups agree on the film's fundamental characteristics, diverging on the verdict about how well it works. In the vast majority of ratings (~91%), the long running time and the contemplative pace are valued by about half as an immersive experience. In addition, a significant share extol the complexity of the female characters, while several stress the friendship among them as the story's emotional axis.
textos.Para os avaliadores que se situam numa f: For the reviewers who fall within a minimal fraction of the ratings (~7%), most point to the excessive length and slowness as tiring aspects; even so, a good portion highlight the focus on interpersonal relationships and communication, while a considerable number report little empathy for the protagonists.
textos.Por fim, na perspectiva de quem compõe u: Finally, from the perspective of those who make up an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~2%), most see the time span and the pacing as obstacles, with many pointing to apathetic, charmless characters, in addition to a dragging script lacking substance.
